label: 分散C008・機内経路表共有・D0基準比較1回目・短縮12件・10秒

definitions.quantiles: Linear interpolation on sorted samples at (N-1)*p, not nearest-rank; integer ms logs are truncated by Rust as_millis().
definitions.graphMs: Wall duration around Graph acquisition in plan_inner only. Includes scheduling delay, cache reuse, and shared cache waiting if present; excludes initial feasible-plan construction, search, later forecast graph construction, and submission. Not CPU time.
definitions.iterations: Outer stochastic search-loop count for one logged plan_inner call. Includes different role weights, primary/forecast budgets, and different trajectories; not fixed-work throughput.
definitions.sample: One completed g007 plan_inner diagnostic across all worker threads, not one match or one official score.
definitions.phaseStage: Phase from preceding dist worker request. Primary day=0 for select, requestId-2 for plan; greater day is forecast. No worker ID in g007 line, so no per-worker pairing.
definitions.caseMapping: Select requests are associated in log order with serial server run cases. Count validation is necessary, not proof of identical input trajectories.
definitions.graphFraction: Sum of logged graph_ms per request / (workers started * request elapsed_ms). Scheduling-inclusive descriptive ratio, not measured CPU utilization or guaranteed recoverable wall time.
definitions.score: Internal g007 score is deliberately not aggregated as official score; worker weights and day vary.
definitions.limits: No GPU attribution, per-stage deadlines, route-query time, or full cache hit metric exists in D0/C007 logs. Format comparisons across versions are observational, not paired identical graph inputs.

scope.meaning: Counter deltas cover only first through last checkpoint; a last before_request_N excludes request N and its work. Full graph_ms quantiles still cover the complete raw evaluation.

definitions.constructionAvoidance: 1-buildStarts/GraphCacheRequests, relative to one build per acquisition; not an observed paired C007 CPU-time saving.
definitions.capacityFallback: bypasses-timeouts; in this implementation this means all retained entry slots are Building when acquiring a distinct key. Does not include ordinary LRU eviction.
definitions.scope: Per-format/phase counter deltas group whole completed requests, including primary and its forecasts; counters cannot identify the internal stage responsible for a bypass.
definitions.timing: buildMs and waitMs sum wall durations across threads, not process wall time or CPU usage. Snapshots are concurrent atomic observations, not a transactional freeze.
definitions.memory: Live/retained tables are byte estimates sampled at request boundaries. peakTableBytesEstimate counts fully built attached tables and lazy cells, omits partially constructed tables, private memos, allocator overhead and RSS retention.
definitions.peakScope: Peak is process-lifetime as of the last snapshot; cannot subtract first peak to get a stage-only peak if a process carried over.
definitions.counterNames: Structured timeouts/failures values must be used; searching for the word timeout in a shared_graph JSON line counts the field name even when zero.

processMemoryAtCompletion.scope: C008 worker process lifetime; VmHWM includes all 12 cases

comparison.kind: observational quantiles, not paired identical input or strength evidence

candidate.scope: C008 worker process lifetime; VmHWM includes all 12 cases

baseline.scope: C007 worker process lifetime; VmHWM includes all 12 cases

processMemoryAtCompletion.meaning: Process RSS/HWM from recorded completion only; check per-process lifetime scope. Counter table bytes are not RSS.
